Vitals — read me first
====================

1. Drag Vitals to the Applications folder next to it.

2. This build is ad-hoc signed (not notarised), so the first launch shows
   "Apple could not verify Vitals is free of malware". Nothing is wrong with
   the download — that is what macOS says about any app that has not been
   through Apple's paid notarisation. Either:

     a. run in Terminal:   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Vitals.app
     b. or open it once, dismiss the error, then System Settings ▸ Privacy &
        Security ▸ scroll to Security ▸ "Open Anyway".

   (Right-click ▸ Open no longer works on macOS 15.)

3. Launch Vitals from Applications. It lives in the menu bar (no Dock icon). The
   first run walks you through the permissions it needs.

Source and newer builds: https://github.com/r-thirumaran/mac-utility
